name: Qualifications Of Elders
overview: The New Testament establishes elders as key leaders appointed by the church through prayer and fasting, entrusted with shepherding the flock under the guidance of the Holy Spirit (Acts 14:23; Acts 20:28). Elders are recognized as overseers and bishops, serving in local churches to maintain order and spiritual health (Acts 20:17; Philippians 1:1; Titus 1:5). Their qualifications include being blameless, faithful in marriage, and having well-behaved children, reflecting their character and ability to lead by example (Titus 1:6). These qualifications underscore the serious responsibility elders bear in caring for the church purchased by Christ’s own blood.
